Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS building a vector-powered product search + conversational support assistant. Ran 4-week Hosted API trial (Feb 1 - Feb 28). Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and cost controls; want sizing + traffic forecast before procurement window in Apr. Very cost sensitive but prioritize 95/99 latency SLOs for UX. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quant.

POC / Hosted trial observations (from SE logs and internal trial sheet):
- Trial ingest: ~1.2M embedding units during trial (mainly nightly re-index).
- Avg user query QPS (prod-like traffic simulated): 12 QPS sustained, daily peak observed 48 QPS (14:00-15:00 UTC).
- Concurrency observed (live eval harness): 16 concurrent inference sessions typical during peak test.
- Token mix (sampled 5000 requests): 60% short (<50 tokens), 30% mid (50-512 tokens), 10% long (>512 tokens). Avg tokens/request = 220.
- Call pattern: ~70% single-turn queries, 30% multi-turn chat where KV cache hits reduce average compute per token.
- Model choices used in trial: open-7B quantized baseline for embeddings + text-gen small Llama-variant tuned for few-shot rerank. They asked about official Redwood-curated 7B vs 13B tradeoffs.
- Cost: Hosted API trial spend $8.6k (trial credits used). Customer extrapolates ~ $10-18k/mo on Hosted at current traffic (w/out optimizations).

Requirements called out by customer:
- Hard: SSO (SAML) integration with Okta, long-term audit logging, KMS integration for key control, EU data residency for subset of PII, SOC2 attestation proof.
- Perf targets: p95 < 220ms for short queries, p95 < 1.2s for mid requests, p99 < 3s for long multi-turn generation (with caching).
- Routing: want fallback to small cheaper variant if higher-tier model unavailable; prefer policy-based routing by latency/cost.

Dedicated sizing ask (what customer asked Redwood SE to estimate):
- Baseline target: support 50 sustained QPS with 4s max context handling and 2k token context in worst-case bursts.
- Peak headroom: handle 150 QPS for promotional spikes with autoscaling / burst capacity.
- Latency targets as above.

Redwood SE preliminary recommendation (Diego Marquez notes, shared 2026-03-07):
- Starter Dedicated cluster: 2 x H100-equivalent (or 2 x A100-80GB) for baseline 50 QPS with continuous batching + KV cache. Use model shard + int8 quant to reduce memory.
- Scale to 4 x H100-equivalent to hit 150 QPS with headroom for 99th percentile targets. Add a dedicated caching tier (NVMe-backed) for large KV snapshots.
- Expected token mix implications: batching will improve throughput for short/mid queries (2-3x better token/sec), long requests still dominated by sequence length — recommend routing long-context requests to separate pool to protect latency.
- Suggested config: dedicated_pool.small (2 GPUs) + dedicated_pool.burst (auto-scale to 4 GPUs). Canary route to hosted_api fallback for non-critical reranks.
